captured_from: WP-169 re-capture on the current tree; scene unchanged from fcf3040 (pre-WP-088, exported with `git archive`)
recapture_reason: WP-169 (H-17) stopped flooring the target-normalization denominator at an absolute 1e-9. t_max = s * u_max**6 collapses as the sixth power of the overlap, so at initialization -- where decode_ltrb has no non-negativity and raw distances decode inverted, leaving IoU near zero -- the floor swamped t_max and crushed every align weight. The one-to-many box and L1 terms were suppressed by ~1.9e6x (4.1e-09 -> 7.70e-03, 3.2e-08 -> 5.86e-02) and the one-to-one pair by ~15x; grad_l2 went 52.111158077994695 -> 88.35660383599993. Only the objective's weighting moved: seeds, config, gains, the two target sets and state_dict_keys are the fcf3040 values, and the assignment itself (which anchors are positive) is unchanged -- WP-169's other fix, H-16, leaves this scene's total bit-identical.
